what: Surface pictures for the kit's materials. tools/fal_textures.py asks fal.ai for each 'prompt' and saves textures/<material>/source.png; tools/make_pbr.py turns that into basecolor, normal and orm maps. 'tile_m' is how many metres one copy of the picture covers in the game; 'tint' multiplies the picture (1 = as generated); 'roughness' is [wettest, driest]. Optional per material: 'style' replaces the shared style, 'seed' fixes the generation, 'crop' keeps only that centre fraction of the picture (the model sometimes draws a framed slab). 'atlas': true marks the colour map of a fal 3D model (meshes/models.json): used as is, not made tileable, and fal_textures.py skips it. 'metallic' (0-1) goes into the ORM map's blue channel. 'seamless': false keeps the picture's own edges (plates that already end in a seam).
style: seamless tileable texture, the surface fills the entire frame edge to edge, no border, no frame, no background, macro close-up photo seen straight on, soft even lighting, muted natural colors, photorealistic, highly detailed, 4k PBR material scan
